name: Angel Fibers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Angel Fibers Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and spinning of varied Cotton Yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a manufacturer and supplier of premium quality ultra-fine knitting yarn made from 100% Cotton, ring, spun, grey, single yarn in – Counts NE 20s to NE 50s – Combed and Carded (Compact) – For Knitting and Weaving

pros: Debtor days have improved from 25.4 to 19.7 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 27.9 days to 19.0 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.19% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.79% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 28.7% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.74 Cr.
